{{Quote|Are you sure you are fully recovered?"<br />"Yes. Where are we going?"<br />"Back to Haariden ... We're going to watch a volcano erupt.|Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Master of Disguise" />}}
'''Kaachtari''' was an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haariden]].<ref name="Master of Disguise" /> In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]'' to [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]. The novel indicates that the volcano erupted a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before its events, equating to [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].</ref> it experienced a massive eruption, in the midst of a world-wide civil war.<ref name="Master of Disguise" />
